name: Johnson & Johnson
summary: Johnson & Johnson, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of a range of products in the healthcare field worldwide. It operates in two segments, Innovative Medicine and MedTech. The Innovative Medicine segment offers products for various therapeutic areas, such as oncology, immunology, neuroscience, pulmonary hypertension, infectious diseases
verdict: Einstufung: Qualität (Buffett-Typ) – erfüllt 7/9 Buffett-Kriterien – stabiler, profitabler Burggraben. Buffett-Score 70/100 (Top-Firma, aber zu teuer), Innovations-Score 34/100 (Noch zu früh/zu teuer). Geschätzter fairer Wert ≈ 264.40 USD (−4 % zum Kurs). Risiko: Niedrig.
